static_traits.name: Kristin Bowman
static_traits.social_status: 有支持的Male友和几位亲密朋友,但尚not yet向他们敞开关于Self-doubt和not值得的感受
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past;此前not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑性好,配合度高,能够自我Reflection,语气平和

basic_info.main_problem: 因为在一次钢琴独奏音乐会中出现了一个错误,我觉得自己not配得到认可或掌声,这影响了自尊与自信.
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到自己存在negate积极,聚焦错误的思维模式,这阻碍了我的音乐成长并造成情绪困扰,因此寻求咨询.
growth_experiences: 几个月前的一次钢琴独奏音乐会:在演出的最后一段出现失误.此后来访者持续反复回想这一错误,认为它毁掉了整场演出,Feeling embarrassed and ashamed;尽管观众给予掌声并在演后有积极评论,来访者仍难以看到表现中的积极面,演奏时常感到Anxiety与压力,Decreased drive,并尝试通过加倍练习和向同伴寻求安慰来应对.该事件成为其自我价值与Damaged confidence的转折点.
Father去世:Father已去世(具体时间与细节Not mentioned).

core_beliefs: 我not值得被认可/not配得到掌声
只有完美without误,我才有价值并配得上认可

special_situations.event: In the last piano solo concert, a mistake occurred in the final section, yet the audience still gave applause and positive comments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果表演中出现一次错误,整场就被我毁掉,我not配得到任何认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍练习,向同伴寻求安慰和认可,negate积极反馈以逼迫自己更完美
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这一切掌声not属于我;我not配被认可

special_situations.event: 每次坐到钢琴前或上台演奏时,都会涌现对那次错误的记忆并出现强烈Anxiety与压力
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我再次犯错,所有人都会认为我not行,整个演出会被我毁掉
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 演前过度Self-monitoring与紧张准备,试图通过用力控制来避免错误
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely make mistakes this time; everyone will be disappointed

special_situations.event: 演后观众的掌声与积极反馈,have not人像我一样关注那次错误
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有完美without误的演奏才算成功并值得认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively replays mistake clips in mind, ignoring positive feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Even when they applaud, I have failed

special_situations.event: 临近新的独奏音乐会,Thinking about possibly making mistakes again而提前Anxiety
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果这次not做到完全完美,就会再次毁掉整场演出
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加班式练习与not断寻求他人保证以求心安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: One mistake and the whole thing is ruined

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen and to gain affirmation through performance
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因失误而被negate,羞辱,自我价值被摧毁
defense_goal: 通过追求完美与Self-monitoring来降低被批评的风险
Maintains suspicion toward positive feedback to avoid disappointment and shame

object_relations.self_representation: not配得到掌声,容易把整场演出'搞砸'的失败者
object_relations.object_representation: The audience/others are judges who will be disappointed and criticize me at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing mistakes in a performance or hearing positive feedback about her performance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在的自我批评Projection到外界,认为观众和他人都在失望和批评自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持温和,Empathy的语气;避免直接反驳其感受;用开放式Questioning邀请其区分事实与推测,鼓励其连接自身情绪并检视证据.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当想到要向Male友或朋友坦诚表达Self-doubt与not配得感受时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为表达会带来负担或被negate,因而选择压住not讲
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气轻柔,允许停顿与Silence;邀请来访者识do not被压住的情绪与身体感受,探讨适度表达的可行边界与支持资源.

manifestations: 将自我价值与'完美without误'绑定,一次错误即negate整场表现与掌声
Finds it hard to accept positive feedback, doubts the meaning of recognition
尽管拥有支持的Male友与朋友,仍not yet向他们敞开关于Self-doubt与not值得的感受

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Insists on the inner rule 'only perfection deserves recognition'
用严格的自我Demandsnegate掌声与积极反馈

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy their original desire would send outward onto themselves, restraining expression toward others or seeking help, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not向Male友和朋友表达真实的Self-doubt与not配得感受
将批评和压力Turning against the self,内在自责

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believes he has disappointed everyone and others will criticize him

能够进行自我Reflection并愿意尝试新的认知重构方法
拥有支持的Male友与几位亲密朋友
Has empathy for others (can view others' mistakes more tolerantly)

target_behavior.behavior: 在弹奏钢琴或演出前后,反复回放错误并negate积极反馈
antecedent: Sitting at the piano to practice or perform on stage
Recalling that mistake during a performance months ago
target_behavior.core_reason: Binds self-worth to perfect performance, black-and-white thinking and mental filtering exist, leading to catastrophic focus on mistakes
target_behavior.function: 试图避免被批评,维持对失误的控制感,短期缓解not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: 表演Anxiety与Increased stress,自尊与Decreased drive,主观体验被负面信息主导

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently seeks comfort and approval from peers (reassurance seeking)
antecedent: 在演前或演后感到Anxiety和Self-doubt时
target_behavior.core_reason: 对外部验证的依赖,内在自我价值not稳定
target_behavior.function: 获得短期的安心与肯定以缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Dependence on external comfort increases, confidence is hard to internalize, and the problem persists
